items.docs: Check the health and status of RSU devices through SNMP communication. You should receive a detailed plain text response that looks like the following example. If the device is off, a 4 second timeout will occur and the ODE will indicate this with an "[ERROR] Empty response" message. (This specific OID returns the amount of time since the device was last powered on) "[1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0 = 0:05:12.59]"
